name: Phalanx Shield
body:
Source Armor Master's Handbook pg. 31
Aura moderate evocation CL 7th
Slot shield; Price 14,080 gp; Weight 30 lbs.
Description
Once per day as a standard action, the wielder of this +2 adamantine tower shield can conjure two spiritual allies (as per the spell). These conjured allies last for 1 minute and can neither attack nor move beyond spaces that are adjacent to the wielder of the phalanx shield. Both allies gain a +4 enhancement bonus to AC and have the Shield WallAPG teamwork feat.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, spiritual allyAPG; Price 9,580 gp
